fact: On 17 October 2024 the Registrar of Companies directed all companies and LLPs to keep a beneficial ownership register and file a copy with the Registrar, with penalties for default and strike-off for non-compliance.
title: Public Notice: Registrar of Companies Directive No. 01 of 2024, Compliance with Section 93A of the Companies Act on the requirement to file beneficial ownership information
publisher: Registrar of Companies, Business Registration Service
